name: Home team starting XI lists exactly eleven players
description: When the per-match lineups artifact is fetched, the home team's starting_xi array contains exactly eleven entries, matching a real football starting lineup.

planSteps.description: Read the first match id from the response
Navigate to /match-lineups/<first-id>.json using the captured id
Read the home.starting_xi array from the lineups artifact
Verify the home.starting_xi array contains exactly eleven player entries
